out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Describes being 'hanging horizontal and weightlessly over my own body' and later 'floating motion like that of a feather'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as a 'tunnel or hallway' filled with blue/white light; endless; no doors/windows/fixtures; absolute silence.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Walking, then 'levitated' and 'whisked backwards at great speed' like a 'gigantic rubber band circling my waist'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Blue/white light; later a brilliant white light filling the hospital room (no windows) that 'should have hurt my eyes but did not'; absolute silence in the tunnel.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Return appears forced/commanded: pulled back like an elastic tether; later told she would not die 'this day' and baby would be born healthy by C-section.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Pulled backwards rapidly; then floated down into body with gradual sensations returning.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to 'Search for My truth... continue to search all the days of your life'; learn to listen in silence; angels guide acts of kindness; implied life-purpose learning/service.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Prolonged obstructed labor with maternal exhaustion/shock risk; later emergency C-section with vital signs near zero per narrative.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Mentions Sunday school, Bible verses, Lord's Prayer, Jesus; not a frequent churchgoer.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Prayed to God/Jesus; describes herself as not spending many Sundays at church; uses Christian prayer language.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Includes auditory/telepathic teachings in hospital room filled with light after return; future preview; 'special name' given.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Death/OBE into tunnel; then forced return to body; then visionary encounter with brilliant light and voices in hospital room (while embodied), including life review and future preview; then medical recovery and later intraoperative crisis (without explicit second OBE).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports observing and participating during crisis ('both observing and participating'); later receives 'download' of information while seeing only light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After returning to body, the hospital room becomes filled with brilliant white light (lights off, no windows) and a booming voice/angels teach and show past/future; also given a 'special name' as a sign of divine presence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "In an instant I was transported to a tunnel or hallway filled with pure, beautiful blue/white light."; "YOU CANNOT GIVE HIM TO ME FOR HE IS ALREADY MINE!"; "You will die, but do not be afraid! Wait, have faith, fear not, pray -- die."; "Death is a shutting of the eyes and walking over into life again."
